description: Presidential Secretariat - Amendment to the Duties & Functions of the Ministers published in Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 1897/15 of 18.01.2015
categorisation: This gazette contains both specific government personnel references (President Maithripala Sirisena) and detailed portfolio responsibilities across multiple ministries. It amends a previous notification by specifying changes to ministerial portfolios, including subject areas, institutions, and legislation under each minister's purview, meeting the criteria for Hybrid classification (Type 3).
